methods.label: Reverse the rows and read the diagonals
methods.explanation:
Reversing a row means reading its entries from right to left. Thus the second row becomes \(11,10,9,8\), and the fourth row becomes \(25,24,23,22\). The first and third rows stay as shown.

The diagonal running from the upper left to the lower right now has sum
\[
1+10+17+22=50.
\]
The diagonal running from the upper right to the lower left has sum
\[
4+9+16+25=54.
\]
Subtract the smaller sum from the larger to get the positive difference:
\[
54-50=\boxed{4}.
\]
The answer is \(\text{B}\).
